svg.title: Insert the contacts: one jumper, one plug
svg.desc: Six steps. One: pinch the plug housing between thumb and forefinger, triangle face up, flat hole face toward you. Two: grip the factory-crimped contact at the base of its metal with needle-nose pliers, spring box pointing forward. Three: push it straight into the left hole, cavity 1, until most of the metal is inside. Four: move the pliers back onto the wire and push gently until the contact stops flush; if it binds, pull back, roll it half a turn and retry, never force it. Five: put the other end of the same 12-inch jumper into the right hole, cavity 2, making a loop, and tug-test both. Six: colour the half from the triangle hole red as far as the middle of the loop, then cut there to make two six-inch leads: red is VO plus, plain is VO minus. Simplified drawing from JST outline dimensions.
svg.text: Insert the contacts: one jumper, one plug
Both ends of ONE 12-inch jumper go into ONE housing; snip the loop afterwards. A spare is useful for practice.
1. Hold the housing
Pinch its sides between thumb and forefinger,
triangle face up, flat hole face toward the
pliers. The rough end points away.
2. Grip the base of the metal
Needle-nose pliers on the crimp at the base of
the metal, contact roughly parallel to the jaws,
spring box pointing forward.
3. Push it most of the way in
Line it up with the LEFT hole (cavity 1) and push
until most of the metal is inside.
4. Re-grip on the wire, seat it gently
Move the pliers back onto the wire and push
gently until it stops flush. Binds? Pull back,
roll it half a turn, retry. Never force it.
5. Other end of the SAME jumper
Steps 2-4 again, into the RIGHT hole (cavity 2).
Hold the housing and tug each wire gently:
neither may move.
6. Colour cavity 1's half red, snip
snip
Marker from the LEFT (triangle) hole to the
middle of the loop; cut there. Two ~6-inch
leads: red = VO+, plain = VO-.
Got them the other way round? Don't dig a contact out.
Colour whichever lead is in the triangle (left) hole red instead. A single speaker works either way round.
